name: Donate Envelope Button
description: Donate button that opens into an animated envelope with an amount input inside. Submitting slides the letter away and reveals a thank you message.
contents: Envelope flap and body drawn with CSS
behavior: Click opens the envelope in a staged sequence and the input slides up out of it
Typing formats the value as a currency amount with thousands dots and two decimals
Click again or form submit sends the letter away and shows the thank you text
Clicking outside closes the envelope until it is submitted
Button background changes on hover while closed
editableByProps: Button label and thank you text
All envelope, button, input and text colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change currency symbol or number format
Hook up a real donation action

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Once submitted the button stays in the thank you state until remount
